Hi Alice / Aurora security team,

Thanks again for taking the intake call last week. As discussed, we put together an initial "runbook" that outlines how Redwood will deliver the SIG/CAIQ artifacts, the sample logs, and the timeline for a one-week evidence sprint. The draft is attached (redwood_runbook_v1.docx).

Quick ask: can you confirm whether you'd prefer inbound S3 transfer (we provide presigned URLs), or a secure Drive upload to your portal? We can support either, but we need to lock the transfer method so we can populate the runbook with the correct steps and roles.

Proposed short timeline (high-level):
- Nov 8: evidence sprint kickoff (30–45 min)
- Nov 9–12: artifact collection window (logs, config snapshots, CAIQ mapping)
- Nov 13: delivery of sample logs and handoff notes

If that timeline looks tight for you, suggest two alternative slots next week for a kickoff: Tue Nov 9 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed Nov 10 14:00–14:45 PT.

Attachment stubs: redwood_runbook_v1.docx (8 pages) — includes CAIQ→SIG mapping appendix; sample policy checklist.

Thanks,

Jordan — thanks for the runbook. I had a quick pass and a few clarifying questions before we lock a kickoff: 

1) Transfer method: our security team prefers S3 presigned PUTs for large log bundles, but we need the retention policy and object encryption details documented. Can you add a one-paragraph note about server-side encryption and object lifecycle in the runbook?

2) Sampling window: for auditing purposes, we need logs covering at least 14 days preceding the sprint start (there's a compliance check). Will your sample-logs-2026-10.tar.gz cover that?

3) Participant list: please confirm an Aurora technical reviewer (we'll use Marcus as primary) and whether Redwood will need privileged access to our storage or if Aurora will push artifacts.

Available for kickoff: Wed Nov 10 14:00 PT works for me. If that slot is confirmed I'll send a calendar invite and the internal reviewer list.

Thanks,

Alice — adding the encryption/lifecycle note now and attaching the sample-logs bundle we prepared for October so you can validate coverage. The attached sample-logs-2026-10.tar.gz contains host and application logs for Oct 1–31; we also included a small README that maps log types to SIG question IDs.

A few operational clarifications we added to the runbook (quick summary):
- Transfer: we can host a pre-signed S3 endpoint (AES-256 SSE) and provide a short-lived presigned PUT; Aurora retains control of the bucket and lifecycle rules.
- Retention note: we will not retain any Aurora artifacts longer than 30 days post-sprint unless you request archival; default behavior is deletion after 30 days.
- Access: Redwood will not request write or admin privileges to your account — uploads via presigned URLs avoid cross-account roles.

CAIQ vs SIG deliverables: we created a single mapping table (Appendix B of the runbook) where each CAIQ question maps to a SIG control and to the specific artifact we will supply (policy, config export, log sample). If you want a different mapping format, we can reformat before the kickoff.

Confirmed slot: Wed Nov 10 14:00–14:45 PT. Jordan / Ben — please confirm you can make that time. Alice — Marcus, thanks for being the internal reviewer; we'll loop him into the invite.

Attachments: sample-logs-2026-10.tar.gz (12 MB), redwood_runbook_v1.docx (updated v1.1)

Cheers,
